sloka: मृतसञ्जीवनीं चैव विशल्यकरणीमपि।सावर्ण्यकरणीं चैव सन्धानकरणीं तथा ।। ६.७४.३३ ।।
transliteration: mṛtasañjīvanīṁ caiva viśalyakaraṇīmapi।sāvarṇyakaraṇīṁ caiva sandhānakaraṇīṁ tathā ।। 6.74.33 ।।

translations.english: "Mrtasanjivani, Visalyakarani, Suvarnakarani, Sandhani, all these herbs are grown there."
